resale_co.name: Certificate for Change in Occupancy or Ownership (Resale/Rental Certificate)
requirements: Smoke alarms on every level and outside each sleeping area: 10-year sealed battery alarms, or hardwired where required
Basement alarm at the bottom of the stairwell on the ceiling (not between joists); hallway alarms close to all bedrooms
Smoke alarms less than 10 years old (or not past the maker's expiration date) and working
Hardwired smoke alarms required by the building code cannot be replaced with battery alarms
Homes with a monitored low-voltage fire alarm system: have it tested by the alarm company before the inspection and bring the certification
CO alarm in the hallway close to all bedrooms, less than 10 years old, UL listed and working

Fire extinguisher rated 2A-10B:C, no more than 10 lb, within 10 feet of the kitchen in the path of egress, top no more than 5 feet above the floor, on the maker's bracket, not in a closet or behind a door; leave the manual for the new occupant (March 2025 checklist)
House numbers at least 3 inches, contrasting, permanently fixed to the house and visible from the street
No open Springfield Township construction permits; all permitted work finalized and passed

fees.label: Each additional inspection after the first two
fees.quote: Two inspections are included.  All additional inspections will be charged a $65.00 fee per inspection.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the Resale/Rental Application (Rev. Mar 2025) from the Construction Office resources, check "Sale", sign it, and submit it with a check or money order for $150.00 payable to "Springfield Township" to the Construction Office, 2159 Jacksonville-Jobstown Road, Jobstown, NJ 08041. The fee is non-refundable. Inspection results and the certificate are sent by email.
resale_co.contact_title: Construction Official, Building and Fire Subcode Official

evidence.quote: The Springfield Construction Office is responsible for construction permits, plan reviews, inspections, and Resale / Rental Certificates as allowed by the State of New Jersey and the Springfield Township code.
All resales shall comply with Springfield Township code 150.2 ‐ Certificate for Change in Occupancy or Ownership.
Check or Money Order for $150.00 payable to Springfield Township submitted with signed Resale/Rental Application.
Inspection results and certificate will be sent via email.
Two inspections are included in this fee. Additional inspections will be charged a $65.00 fee per inspection.
Construction Offical, Building and Fire Sub-code Official

resale_co.notes: The leads file pointed to springfield-nj.us, which is Springfield Township in Union County; the Burlington County township site is www.springfieldtownshipnj.org (Jobstown). Its forms are served through a document viewer: the application link opens the viewer page, and the direct PDF address (/api/blob/viewBlob?i=...) returns the PDF only when opened from the site (automated fetches without a referring page get the viewer instead). Staff names and titles come from the township's staff widget data (app.membershipware.com), shown on the Construction Office page; the site spells the title "Construction Offical". Other contact: Kathy Warnebold, Technical Assistant to the Construction Official, construction@springfieldtownshipnj.org, 609-723-2464 (Tuesday to Thursday 8:00AM to 1:00PM). The same application covers rentals; for rentals built before 1978 a lead-safe certificate is also required.

requirements: 10-year sealed battery smoke alarms (or hardwired as required) on every level and near all bedrooms; alarms under 10 years old
Hardwired alarms cannot be replaced with battery alarms
CO alarms under 10 years old in the hallway near all bedrooms
Fire extinguisher 2A-10B:C, 10 lb maximum, mounted within 10 feet of the kitchen, top no higher than 5 feet (March 2025 township checklist still lists it)

authorities.name: Springfield Township Construction Office (designated for smoke detector compliance; NJ DCA is the fire code enforcing agency)
authorities.how_to_apply: The smoke alarm, CO alarm and extinguisher checks (N.J.A.C. 5:70-4.19) are part of the $150 resale inspection; see the resale certificate section. No separate smoke certificate form or fee was found.
authorities.contact_title: Construction Official, Building and Fire Subcode Official

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA is the fire code enforcing agency for Springfield Township (LEA registry code S). The DCA state-towns list (revised 7/17/2026) lists Springfield Twp without the "SC" (smoke certs) flag, and the state directory (three fire company pages) names the Springfield Twp Construction Office, PO Box 119, Jobstown, (609) 723-2464, for smoke detector compliance. The township resale checklist is built on the state smoke/CO/extinguisher rule.

other_items.label: Open construction permits closed
other_items.detail: No outstanding Springfield Township construction permits; all permitted work must be finalized and passed before the resale inspection passes.

other_items.label: Rental registration deactivated
other_items.detail: If the property was a rental, the landlord registration is deactivated on the resale application.

open_questions: Lead time before closing and certificate validity are not published.
Confirm the extinguisher is still required given P.L.2025, c.19; the March 2025 checklist lists it.
